name: The House Call
pitch: You heal your enemy, laughing, because every wound you close on them makes your next needle hurt more: their bar climbs back to 100 % while you get dangerous, and then the two bars cross.

new.name: Both Sides

new.name: Joy of the Work
new.effect: Health you restore to the other side counts 3 times as health you restored, for anything that reads it.
